newsitem.title: CHINA: Firstone jumps on Guangnan participation.
newsitem.headline: Firstone jumps on Guangnan participation.

text.p: Shares of Firstone International Holdings Ltd shot higher on Friday on short-term speculative buying fuelled by hopes of a strong earnings outlook after it placed shares to a Chinese partner, brokers said.

"The stock was becoming a red chip following Guangnan taking a stake in the company and that led to anticipation of stronger prospects in China, which fuelled the strong demand," said Edwin Cheung, sales manager of Taiwan Securities.
"But the rise was a bit too sharp," he added.
Firstone shares resumed trading after a four-day suspension and hit a high of HK$1.48 before settling down to trade HK$0.71, or 112 percent, higher at HK$1.34.
Volume was 114 million shares worth HK$143 million.

The capacitor maker and Chinese wine distributor said on Friday it would place 313.84 million new shares, or 22.48 percent of the enlarged share capital, to third-party Guangnan (Holdings) Ltd at HK$0.40 per share.
Guangnan shares gained HK$0.10 to HK$11.60.
